VAL-BOOK-029.observed: On /acme/website (Customer data region control) the change-region dialog showed the reservation warning 'Reservation records will be deleted too' with Reservations: 83 (69 upcoming), Guests: 80, Tables: 39, Waitlist entries: 2, Active holds: 0 and 'Type acme to confirm'. With 'wrong-slug' typed the 'Delete data and switch' button was disabled; with 'acme' it became enabled (no switch submitted). POST of the region action (intent=update-site-data-region, dataRegion=ksa, confirmWipe=true) without confirmText and with confirmText=nope both returned HTTP 400 with body reservationsConfirmationRequired:true and error 'This organization has reservation records in the current region that would be deleted. Type the organization slug to confirm.'; reservationsSummary counts were included. Organization.dataRegion for acme stayed 'us' (hasProvisionedDb 1) and the seeded rows (RSVACM101..107, 2026-10-16) are unchanged. On the disposable org g16-disposable (provisioned tenant DB, reservations 0, guests 0, waitlist 0, holds 0, tables 0, staff 0 - internal /internal/reservations/summary returned all zeros) the dialog showed no reservation warning, no slug input at all, and 'Delete data and switch' enabled immediately; GET /resources/reservations/region-summary?orgSlug=g16-disposable returned 200 with requiresConfirmation:false. No switch was performed anywhere (both orgs still dataRegion=us).
VAL-BOOK-029.notes: The action's typed field is confirmText (the contract calls it confirmOrgSlug); behavior matches. The dialog's staffing block was absent for acme because acme has zero staff records (RegionStaffGuard returns null when no confirmation is required), so the reservation warning appeared alone; the reservations block itself is the same component pattern. The zero-data clause was exercised on a real provisioned-but-empty org created through /organizations/create (g16-disposable, left in place).

VAL-BOOK-031.observed: Temporary secondary location 'G16-Temp' was created through /acme/settings/locations/new (id b5hymj7733l3wxrg74dytzty), given an area (G16-Area), one table (G16-T1) and one service (G16-Dinner, 17:00-23:00 daily) through the setup API, then a future reservation (2026-10-28 18:30, party 2, G16-T1) was created through POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations. POST /internal/reservations/location-summary returned HTTP 200 with futureReservations 1, activeFutureReservations 1, canDelete false. In /acme/settings/locations/<id>, Delete Location -> Confirm Delete returned HTTP 409 and the UI displayed 'Cannot delete this location while it has 1 active future reservation. Cancel or move them first.'; the Location row stayed in local D1. After the reservation was cancelled (POST .../status {status:'cancelled'}), location-summary returned futureReservations 0, canDelete true, and the same Delete Location flow succeeded: the browser redirected to /acme/settings/locations and the Location row was gone from D1 (only Downtown and Waterfront remain).
VAL-BOOK-031.notes: The internal location-summary call is made server-side by the App, so it does not appear in the browser network log; the browser request that is visible is POST /acme/settings/locations/<id>.data -> 409. The internal route was exercised directly with curl (401 without token, 200 with the internal token). The delete-clean path also required the historical (cancelled) row to be acceptable, which canDelete:true confirmed.

VAL-CROSS-004.observed: GET /resources/reservations/region-summary?orgSlug=acme returned 200 (Cache-Control private, no-store) with {activeLocations:2, reservations:83, upcomingReservations:69, guests:80, waitlistEntries:2, activeWaitlist:2, holds:0, activeHolds:0, tables:39, auditEntries:134} and requiresConfirmation:true - exactly the numbers the dialog rendered (Reservations 83 (69 upcoming), Guests 80, Tables 39, Waitlist entries 2, Active holds 0). POST http://localhost:3007/internal/reservations/summary with the internal token and {"orgId":"t58bgatqh3rv0s3movrecyj1"} returned the same counts (reservations 83, upcomingReservations 69, guests 80, waitlistEntries 2, activeHolds 0, tables 39) plus byLocation breakdown. Unauthenticated internal call -> 401. Region action without confirmText and with a wrong slug -> 400 reservationsConfirmationRequired; Organization.dataRegion unchanged (us); the acme tenant DB still holds the seeded RSVACM101..107 rows and Today still lists reservations (screenshot). VAL-CROSS-004.notes: The counts are live shared data; the dialog, the App resource route and the regional internal route were compared within the same minute (all 83/80/2/39). The raw tenant DB has 43 table rows of which 4 are archived, which is why the API/dialog report 39. The staffing counts block is not rendered for acme because its staff summary is all zeros.

VAL-CROSS-005.observed: In /acme/reservations/settings/floor-plan (location Downtown) I moved G16-M1 from (200,200) to (250,320), resized G16-R1 from 80x80 to 120x60 and added a new table in G16-Area renamed 'P-9' at (600,300); Save -> PUT /operator/reservations/setup/locations/v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8/floor-plan 200 and banner 'Floor plan saved (v73).' A second tab opened before the Save (its own draft: G16-R1 x=410) got PUT -> 409 and the conflict banner 'Stale floor plan version (409 conflict): another operator saved changes since you opened this floor plan...' while its draft was kept (unsaved badge, x still 410). The live Floor for G16-Area rendered P-9 at left 600/top 300, G16-M1 at left 250/top 320 and G16-R1 at left 400/top 200 with width 120 - matching the saved draft (the floor view clamps rendered size to a 96x84 minimum, which is why 80/70-wide tables display 96 wide). From Today a walk-in party of 2 was seated on P-9 (POST /operator/reservations/book/walk-ins 201): Today's 'Currently Seated' column showed 'P-9 - Walk-in Guest (2) | 0m / 75m', the Floor showed 'P-9 ... Walk-in G. | 2p | 0m - 1514m left' (running timer), and the Timeline (business date 2026-10-17) showed the occupancy bar on the P-9 row ('Walk-in Guest, party of 2, 21:33, 75 minutes, table P-9, locked'). Archiving P-9 in Settings -> Tables (DELETE .../tables/tbl_mvbq0sv3_4fytp 200) removed it from the Floor (G16-Area then listed only G16-M1 and G16-R1) and the Settings conflicts panel listed 5 rows. The future booking I had assigned to P-9 (2026-10-28 18:30, soft) was auto-reflowed to another table (auto_reassigned event) rather than left unassigned; the panel's P-9-related row was the seated walk-in as archived_table (2026-10-17). Archiving G16-M1 with a locked future booking on it produced an archived_table conflict row for 2026-10-28 at the endpoint.
VAL-CROSS-005.notes: DEFECT (conflicts view rendering, also the UI clause of VAL-SETUP-025): the Settings panel 'Upcoming Reservation Conflicts' renders each row as '\u00b7 (p)' with no confirmation code, no date, no party size and an empty reason badge, because the UI renders conflict.confirmationCode/businessDate/partySize/reason while GET /operator/reservations/setup/locations/<id>/conflicts returns {kind, bookingId, tableId|serviceId, details:{businessDate}} (5 rows at that moment: table_overlap 2026-10-16, archived_table 2026-10-17 (my walk-in on P-9), unassigned 2026-10-25, table_overlap 2026-10-27, archived_table 2026-10-28 (my locked booking on G16-M1)). Also: the affected soft future booking was auto-reflowed to another table on archive (auto_reassigned) instead of being left unassigned, so the literal 'listed as unassigned' wording did not apply to it; a locked booking on an archived table does appear as archived_table at the endpoint. The assertion's own pass criteria (no drift between editor and live floor; stale-version conflict reported and draft kept) were met.

VAL-CROSS-006.observed: 1) The table block could NOT be created through the UI: in /acme/reservations/settings/special-days the block form (date 2026-10-28, table M1, 19:30-21:30, reason private_event) POSTed {"businessDate":"2026-10-28","startMin":1170,"endMin":1290,"tableId":"tbl_acme_m1",...} to /operator/reservations/setup/locations/<loc>/blocks and got HTTP 500 {"error":"Internal Server Error"}; the tenant-api log shows an unhandled error inserting into rsv_blocks with start_at/end_at bound as ZonedTime objects ({instantMs:...}); the same payload by curl reproduces 500, while the same route with startAt/endAt as epoch milliseconds returns 201 (that is how the two blocks used for this test were created). 2) After the blocks (M1 and M2, 2026-10-28 19:30-21:30) the soft booking rsv_36a16b28-... moved from M1 to G4-1 with an auto_reassigned event {"fromTableIds":["tbl_acme_m1"],"toTableIds":["tbl_1f1bb120-..."]}; the Timeline shows the bar on G4-1's row and the detail sheet's Audit Trail lists 'created | operator' and 'auto_reassigned | system' (the sheet does not render the old/new table ids; they are only in the events API). However NO auto-move notice was shown: the day feed has no moveNotices key, the Timeline's 'Unassigned & Conflicts' badge was 0, and its panel showed 'Automatic Reflow Notices | 0 | No recent turn-extension table reflows.' 3) The guest manage view does not exist in this milestone: GET http://localhost:3007/reservations/manage (Origin http://acme.menuza.test:3008) -> 404, POST -> 404, and Sites /reserve/manage -> 404, so the guest-side clause is not exercisable. 4) The locked booking rsv_3b88b072-... stayed on M2 (no auto_reassigned event, locked:true) - never auto-moved - but it did not appear in the Timeline's unassigned/conflict panel (0 unassigned, 0 conflicts there); it appears only in the Settings conflicts endpoint as {kind:'blocked_table', bookingId:rsv_3b88b072-..., tableId:tbl_acme_m2, date:2026-10-28}, which the Settings panel renders as an unreadable '\u00b7 (p)' row.
VAL-CROSS-006.notes: Three distinct gaps: (a) block creation from the App UI 500s (server bug: localToInstant ZonedTime objects inserted into rsv_blocks), (b) the auto-move notice is never shown to the host (day feed carries no moveNotices; the timeline conflict panel's 'Automatic Reflow Notices' stays 0 even right after an auto-reassignment), and (c) the locked booking under the block is not surfaced in the timeline's unassigned/conflict panel (the App only computes overlap conflicts client-side). The 'hosts see the move' clause is only half met (the row moves and the audit event exists; no notice). The guest clause cannot be tested this milestone (routes 404). Console errors: none observed on the timeline/floor/settings pages used.

friction.description: VAL-CROSS-006 step 1 is not executable through the UI: creating a table block in Settings -> Special days & Blocks returns HTTP 500 (rsv_blocks insert binds ZonedTime objects for start_at/end_at).
friction.resolution: Reproduced with curl (same payload -> 500) and worked around by calling the same route with startAt/endAt epoch milliseconds (201), which allowed steps 2 and 4 of the assertion to be exercised.

friction.description: The Settings 'Upcoming Reservation Conflicts' panel renders every row as '\u00b7 (p)' with an empty reason badge: the UI renders confirmationCode/businessDate/partySize/reason, but the API returns kind/bookingId/details.businessDate.
friction.resolution: Reported as a defect; raw endpoint payload saved as evidence.

friction.description: The detail sheet's Audit Trail shows only the event action and actor, not the old/new table ids of an auto_reassigned event (the ids exist in GET /reservations/:id/events).
friction.resolution: Reported; the ids were verified through the events API.

friction.description: The region dialog closed itself once while typing in the confirmation input (the state was re-rendered by the guard fetchers); it had to be reopened to continue.
friction.resolution: Reopened the select and typed again; the wrong-slug screenshot had already been captured.

friction.description: POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id/status expects the target status in `status` (or `toStatus`), not `to` as the architecture route table suggests; the first attempt returned 409 invalid_status_transition with an empty target.
The live Floor view clamps rendered table size to a 96x84 minimum, so small tables (80x80, 70x70) display larger than their saved geometry even though left/top match exactly.
friction.resolution: Noted as a rendering rule (Math.max(96, width) / Math.max(84, height) in floor.tsx); positions and larger widths match the draft exactly.

friction.description: The app's current business date is 2026-10-17 while the round guidance treats 2026-10-16 as 'today'; a walk-in created 'now' landed on business date 2026-10-17 at 21:33 local (the location's local clock reads 2026-10-16 21:33), so the Timeline must be opened for 2026-10-17 to see it.
friction.resolution: Opened the Timeline without a date parameter (2026-10-17) for the walk-in occupancy row; reported as an observation, outside my assertions.

summary: 4 of 5 assigned assertions tested through the real surfaces: VAL-BOOK-029, VAL-BOOK-031 and VAL-CROSS-004 pass (region guard counts/typed slug/400 reservationsConfirmationRequired with dataRegion and seeded rows unchanged; a zero-data disposable org needs no confirmation; the location-delete guard blocks on a future reservation and deletes cleanly after cancelling it). VAL-CROSS-005 passes its geometry/stale-version criteria (editor Save v73 drives the live floor, second tab gets 409 and keeps its draft, walk-in seated on P-9 shows on Today/Floor/Timeline, archiving P-9 removes it from the floor) but the Settings conflicts panel renders its rows without code/date/party/reason (defect, also the UI clause of VAL-SETUP-025). VAL-CROSS-006 fails: creating a block via the UI 500s, no auto-move notice is shown to the host, and the locked booking under the block is not surfaced in the timeline's unassigned/conflict panel (only in the settings conflicts endpoint as blocked_table); the guest manage clause is not testable this milestone (routes 404). Working tree left clean (git status empty on pr/reservations); browser session d15910fb8c20__g16 closed. Cleanup: G16-M1/G16-R1/P-9 tables and G16-Area archived on Downtown, G16-Temp location deleted, G16 reservations cancelled or left as recorded; disposable org g16-disposable (tzlmsc1gpehdl7zk7uo23dyi) left in place with its provisioned empty tenant DB.
